readings.heading: Ὁ Ἀπόστολος — 1 Corinthians 4:9–16
verses: 9. Brothers and sisters: it seems to me that God has put us apostles on show at the very end of the procession, like men under sentence of death. We have been made a spectacle for the whole world to watch — for angels and for human beings alike.
10. We are fools for Christ's sake; you are so wise in Christ. We are weak; you are strong. You are honoured; we are treated as nobodies.
11. Right up to this present hour we go hungry and thirsty, we are poorly clothed, we are knocked about, and we have no settled home.
12. We wear ourselves out working with our own hands. When people abuse us, we bless them. When they persecute us, we put up with it.
13. When they slander us, we answer kindly. We have become the scrapings of the world, the muck everyone wipes off — right up to this moment.
14. I am not writing this to shame you, but to warn you as my own dear children.
15. Because even if you had ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers. It was I who became your father in Christ Jesus, through the gospel.
16. So I am asking you: follow my example.

readings.heading: Τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον — Matthew 17:14–23
verses: 14. At that time, when they had come back down to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus, knelt in front of him,
15. and said: "Lord, have mercy on my son. He is moon-struck and suffers terribly — he keeps falling into the fire, and again and again into the water.
16. I brought him to your disciples, and they were not able to cure him."
17. Jesus answered: "You unbelieving and twisted generation — how long must I be with you? How long do I have to put up with you? Bring him here to me."
18. Jesus spoke sharply to the demon, and it came out of the boy, and the child was healed from that moment.
19. Then the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, "Why couldn't we drive it out?"

20. He said to them: "Because your faith is too small. I tell you the truth: if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.
21. But this kind does not come out except by prayer and fasting."
22. While they were together in Galilee, Jesus said to them: "The Son of Man is going to be handed over into human hands.
23. They will kill him — and on the third day he will be raised." And they were deeply grieved.
